Please annotate functions with a trailing `()`, so `decode_state_sensor_pdr_data()`.

Noted. 
I have modified the commit message and the function names is now carrying the trailing `()`.
This is expected so isn't necessary to mention. Please remove it.

Understood, I have removed the line.
Thanks for acknowledging!

This shouldn't be the case, see:

https://github.com/openbmc/libpldm/blob/76f6997a9c85556fbc01f8553bb0fa986d4d79a6/CONTRIBUTING.md#L238-L241

Apologize for the mistake.
I have modified the implementation and the decoder is now returning  negative `errno` instead of PLDM completion code.

The current preference is that new changelog entries go at the top of their section:


https://github.com/openbmc/libpldm/blob/76f6997a9c85556fbc01f8553bb0fa986d4d79a6/CONTRIBUTING.md#L49

This also needs to be moved due to the release of v0.16.0.
Thanks for acknowledging, I have moved the entry to the top of the document.

I rather we take a longer path here and avoid introducing more uses of `struct pldm_state_sensor_pdr`. Instead I prefer we deprecate it and introduce `struct pldm_platform_state_sensor_pdr` as its replacement. `struct pldm_platform_state_sensor_pdr` should meet current expectations outlined in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Are you happy to work through that process?

Sure! I have modified the implementation in PS6 to introduce `struct pldm_platform_state_sensor_pdr` as the new decode target, and has refined the decode function to `decode_pldm_platform_state_sensor_pdr()`.

In addition, I kept this commit purely additive and deferred the deprecation of `pldm_state_sensor_pdr` and the migration of its existing readers to a focused follow-up.

If you'd prefer the deprecation marker to land in this commit anyway, I'm happy to add it, thanks!
